name: 39401 · Hattiesburg, MS
findings: ZIP 39401 (Hattiesburg) has 113 nonprofit organizations. 47 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 37 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (34% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 39401 (Hattiesburg) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 11 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.
